name: thread-brief
title: Thread brief
description: Each session's objective, what's next, what's done, what's blocked and what was parked, kept current by its agent in the side panel, with a Briefs list of them all.
author: Ghostex
agentNote: Ghostex shows this session's thread brief in its Thread brief side panel. Once you have a task, keep it current with the thread-brief skill (or run `ghostex extensions message thread-brief read` to see it), updating it at the end of any turn in which something material changed.
